$comment: Measured rows for the fact sheets, built by Tools/data/measure_places.py. altitude: metres, percentiles of the land inside the boundary (Mapzen Terrarium zoom 10). slope: median slope in degrees and share of land steeper than 30% (CERVIM's steep-slope mark), from the same tiles; ~115 m pixels read narrow slopes gentler. koppen: share of the boundary area per Köppen-Geiger class (Beck et al. 2023, 1991-2020), classes under 5% dropped. places: one row per place. country.spain: the same measures over all of Spain's land (spain-mask.json); country.portugal: the same over Portugal's land (CAOP municipios and the Madeira islands); country.france and country.italy: Köppen only, over France's and Italy's land (countries/fr and countries/it mask.json), their altitude not measured yet. Portuguese, French and Italian places use Köppen polygons made by Tools/data/koppen_country.sh. regions: the same measures over the union of a study region's appellation-level places (parent spain, portugal, france or italy; zones excluded), for comparisons. See data/SOURCES.md.
